info.name: B2B Platform admin — live only
info.description:
# Platform admin — live routes only

Generated 2026-09-17 from route:list.
Import docs/api/environments/platform-web.postman_environment.json.
baseUrl is the host only. Seed: admin@platform.sy / password.
This is NOT the channel dashboard.
